summary: The running-back weekly ranking edge over expert consensus, discovered on 2023-25 (RB within-position Spearman 0.7215 vs 0.6958, won 3/3, pooled p=0.002), replicates cleanly on the disjoint 2020-22 seasons it was NOT found on: RB ours 0.6658 vs consensus 0.6415, won 3/3, pooled delta +0.0243 with a paired 95% CI [+0.0066, +0.0437] that excludes zero. The effect is RB-specific — QB loses (-0.0631), TE and WR are ties — which argues for a real workload signal rather than a cross-positional artifact. Both pre-registered criteria (RB wins >=2/3 seasons AND pooled delta > 0) are met.
spec: pre-registered in .superpowers/sdd/progress.md (2026-07-22), before these artifacts were trained

design.hypothesis: The 2023-25 RB weekly edge generalizes to seasons not used to find it.
design.method: ensemble {v1,v1_s43,v1_s44}/through{S-1} predicts weekly S; within-position weekly RB Spearman vs weekly FantasyPros ECR, scored through the sign-safe committed eval/weekly_rankings.py (goodness scores, assert_model_sane tripwire) with leak-safe weekly_snapshot; model trained on seasons <= S-1 only, lag features strictly prior.
design.no_tuning: No hyperparameter or feature choice was made against 2020-22; the earlier-fold configs (transformer_v1_through2019/2020/2021.yaml) are pure v1, only val_season differs.

pre_registered_rule.criterion: RB ours > consensus in >=2 of 3 out-of-sample seasons AND pooled mean delta > 0.
pre_registered_rule.note: This is a replication test, not a promotion gate. Anything less would mean the 2023-25 RB edge did not generalize (honest negative).

interpretation: RB is the only position where the model out-ranks weekly consensus out-of-sample. A global calibration or scoring artifact would lift every position; this lifts only the one whose value is workload-driven (carries, targets, snap share) — exactly what the model's usage features capture. The delta is nearly identical across the two disjoint sets (+0.026 discovery, +0.024 out-of-sample), and the paired CI excludes zero. The edge is claimable.
